value.reason: One core owner, one build job and one isolated target. All lifecycle/registration/finalization/extension writes are serial under the same WI lock. No parallel registration, lease or missing declaration is inferred from this boundary.

acceptanceCriteria: A1: 只对真实可读的完整旧 v1 原始字节、完整适用 payload 与验证依赖进行显式登记；来源须绑定固定快照、repository/WI/Contract/close/provider 和当前来源接受声明。一个用户提供 hash、不同 checkout 路径或两份相同摘要表均不足；缺来源返回 provenance_unknown。
A2: 所有旧 v1、archive、Contract、close、verification 和 provider 历史字节保持；canonical 与 raw digest 分列。新记录诚实绑定当前 Runtime、当前实际操作者 explicit_attestation 和当前 recordedAt，不声称旧 producer 重新认证，不将历史验证提升为当前 verified。
A3: requirement 与 registration 使用新严格 schema、固定逐 WI subject、精确原始字节绑定、bounded inventory/dependencyBindings 和 no-replace 发布。requirement 先持久化并包含首次准确 registration 模板；已发布路径不删除回滚，不覆盖冲突，临时文件不成为成功证明。
A4: plan 全只读，并能对 requirement-only、registration-only 等中断状态生成合法受约束恢复计划；pending 完整性 blocker 不得永久锁死相同 binding 的 resume。恢复只允许首次准确原 bytes 与原 binding；损坏或不同内容必须冲突，不能用新计划覆盖。

A5: 同 WI 同 binding 并发只产生一个权威结果并返回首次原 actor/time/Runtime；不同 binding 冲突。plan 后来源、目标、inventory、provider head 或准入漂移应 stale/conflict。每个 canonical 发布点和报告失败均有中断/abrupt-exit 回归，准确区分 pending、committed 与 commit_state_unknown。
A6: 路径读取和发布拒绝跨 WI/repository、绝对或非 normal 路径、重复 JSON key/路径、超量超大、symlink/reparse 及父目录替换；no-replace 不改变已有目录、不同内容或 hardlink victim。完整 inventory 须从适用历史结构重建，并校验 delegated/raw/observation/successor 等真实依赖。
A7: 登记义务存活时逐类缺失/篡改 v1、payload、Contract/archive/close/verification/provider/dependency 或本地双记录均 fail closed：撤销 closed、blocking=true、明确诊断、readiness 保留该 WI、重叠 scope 的 start/preflight 被拒。

A8: unresolved 枚举合并 archive/Contract 与 requirement/registration/extension ID；整个 archive 目录丢失、archive+Contract 双删、closeRequired=false、Contract 改 foreign 并重算 manifest 均不能绕过。scope 缺失或不可信保留 archived_work_item_scope_untrusted，successor 豁免不吞掉登记完整性失败；避免 status/历史链/登记验证递归。

A9: 登记前已有合法 Deleted 时 root 完整纳入该 transition/依赖；登记后合法 Retained→Deleted 在同 WI lifecycle lock 与既有 finalization 协议中发布精确 extension requirement 再发布 transition。正常 finalize 与显式 extension record 只有一个权威写入核心，CLI/MCP 只是薄入口。
A10: extension requirement 持久化首次准确 transition 模板及序列化版本。重试先识别已发布且与原义务完全相同的 transition，读回验证后返回原结果，再判断 next sequence；不能先 resolve 当前 head 后 sequence+1。不得重生成时间、actor、Runtime 或其他原 bytes。
A11: root/extension pending 使用仅允许相同 binding 与准确原 bytes 的受约束 resume 准入，不先要求普通 registered_valid/closed。缺一 pending，可恢复；新计划不能变成修复损坏记录、覆盖冲突或接受未绑定新 decision 的后门。
A12: public finalization writer 获取既有同 WI lifecycle lock；明确类型或调用约定的 internal unlocked 核心仅供持锁入口使用，防止重入与无锁外泄。补直接/持锁调用、race、成功发布但回报失败重试、合法 append、非法 next/fork/错身份/资源仍在的回归。
A13: 普通 close、现有 v2、未登记可读旧 v1 保持既有读兼容且不自动迁移；完整旧 producer/当前 registrar 不同的 fixture 保留 historical_evidence_not_revalidated。全部本地要求记录、登记、来源及独立锚一起消失/整体回滚的不可识别边界明确公开，不引入远端可信单调登记簿。
A14: CLI/MCP 对成功、unknown、幂等、漂移、proof loss 和 constrained resume 有一致错误、状态、严格参数和写边界；三语 commands/workflow 同步说明来源、身份和全来源丢失边界，纠正与现行 published-path 保留规则不一致的回滚描述。
A15: 核心实现前等待 Raydot 本轮独立方案审阅结论。实施获准后保留聚焦 RED/GREEN 和 Contract 声明的完整 workspace/仓库门禁真实回执；一个隔离 target、单构建任务、正式验证 900 秒上限，不改断言或门禁、不无意义重跑历史验证，保留失败证据。
A16: 必要阶段材料和源码正常提交推送本独立工作分支，保持一个 WI/branch/worktree；不擅自创建或合并新 PR、Ready、close、cleanup 或发布。实际 #1004 历史登记、WI-1084/其他保留资源和本地 Sentinel 不在此次授权内。

A17: 完整独立方案审阅已通过；实现仍按当前 Runtime 和真人门禁准入。internal unlocked 核心须 crate 私有并受同 repository/WI 的锁 guard 类型/身份约束，防重入与无锁外泄；跨 WI 只读依赖验证使用 visited/depth 限制并对循环/超限 fail closed。成功登记后的 status 不默认要求原来源 checkout 永久在线，必需外部依赖必须明确声明并保留其失败语义。损坏记录先由严格 canonical 文件名参与 WI 枚举，不得因 JSON 损坏或 foreign 字段提前跳过。registered-valid、原 v1 有效、完整 inventory/provider 有效必须合取，登记不能覆盖旧验证失败。

concurrencyBoundary.reason: One core owner, one build job and one isolated target. All lifecycle/registration/finalization/extension writes are serial under the same WI lock. No parallel registration, lease or missing declaration is inferred from this boundary.

previousContract.goal: 实现本地 requirement + registration 不可变双记录、完整来源及 payload 校验、受约束中断恢复和唯一 Retained→Deleted 扩展写入核心；CLI/MCP 共用实现并保持普通 close、v2 和未登记旧 v1 的兼容边界。

guidelines: Raydot has ordinary technical review authority delegated by Ray. This approval admits scaffold/Contract preparation; it is not a fresh identity-bound human confirm_review or approval to close, merge, publish or clean resources.

Raydot full independent design review has passed and ordinary technical authority to implement this bounded plan is now present. Continue only under actual Runtime admission; the currently required identity-bound human confirm_review remains unsatisfied.

Single core implementation owner; lifecycle, shared files and producer-consumer writes serial. Read-only review or independent documentation may parallelize only without shared mutation; no cross-WI lease is assumed.
Preserve doctor red attribution to existing historical evidence scripts and five unrelated active records; do not alter them to obtain admission.

Pending root/extension recovery must be explicitly admitted by exact durable obligation and requested bytes, not by ordinary registered_valid/closed; malformed/conflicting published data never becomes overwriteable.

当前操作者仅 explicit_attestation，不重新认证旧 producer；全部本地来源丢失不可识别。
root 和 extension 的中断恢复仅同 binding/准确原 bytes；单一权威 finalization 写入核心、同 WI lifecycle lock。
Raydot 完整独立技术审阅已通过；实施须按 Runtime 真实准入，当前敏感 amend 的真人 confirm_review 尚未记录。
nonGoals: Rewriting or silently migrating old v1 receipts, historical producer identity/time, archive/Contract/close/verification/provider bytes, or representing historical verification as current execution.
Remote trusted monotonic registry, new external trust service, bulk migration, and claims that total loss or rollback of all local provenance is detectable.
Actual source registration or historical repair of real WI-1004 records; this implementation uses isolated fixtures until a separate exact target authority exists.
WI-1084 reopening, PR1040 body changes, WI-1078 retained resources/evidence, other worktrees or dirty files, local Sentinel, Task9, and global Agent/MCP/security/permission configuration.
Release publication, tags, new PR creation without direction, Ready/merge, human close, branch/worktree deletion or resource cleanup.
General finalization, evidence cache or coordination refactoring; unrelated CI/release workflows, assertions or gate weakening.
intent.problem: Existing readable legacy-v1 recovery evidence has no new v2 origin requirement. Losing all legacy provenance can be indistinguishable from ordinary close; no historical origin may be fabricated. A new explicit present-day registration must remember complete proof obligations while preserving the known total-local-loss boundary and lawful append-only Retained-to-Deleted evolution.
intent.rationale: 将旧 v1 的已知来源丢失边界作为独立新范围，追加现时完整性义务；不重开已完成 WI-1084 或改写历史。
intent.userGoal: 维护者能够对完整旧 v1 证据登记现在核验的来源，并在登记后证据丢失或损坏时获得明确阻断，避免错误释放关闭状态与 scope，同时保留真实历史和合法 Retained→Deleted 追加。

Release publication, tags, new PR creation without direction, Ready/merge, human close, branch/worktree deletion or resource cleanup.
General finalization, evidence cache or coordination refactoring; unrelated CI/release workflows, assertions or gate weakening.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Present-day explicit_attestation is truthful; original historical bytes and assurance remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a complete old-v1 source with historical producer distinct from present registrar; reject hash-only/incomplete sources.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Only exact original binding/bytes resume; pending does not permanently block its own recovery; conflicting or corrupt records remain preserved and rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt before/after requirement and registration publication; plan and record requirement-only and registration-only cases.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Single immutable winner, no lost update, stale/conflict on drift, no overwrite.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Race same/different WI and binding; change source/destination/inventory/head/admission after plan.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No escaped read/write or victim replacement; invalid inputs fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise bounded reads, duplicate keys/paths, symlink/reparse, directory replacement, traversal and hardlink victims.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Closed revoked, explicit blocker, WI retained in readiness, overlapping scope rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Remove/change each required record/dependency; remove archive directory or Contract+manifest; set closeRequired=false or foreign repository.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: One authoritative write sequence; typed held-lock/internal contract prevents recursive acquisition and unlocked exposure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Call normal finalization and explicit extension path with held/unheld lock contexts and concurrent writers.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Read back original exact transition and return original result; no regenerated actor/time/Runtime bytes and no false next-sequence conflict.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Publish exact transition, fail reporting, then retry with original durable template/version before evaluating next-sequence.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Exact constrained resume works without prior registered_valid/closed; unbound decisions, invalid forks and missing proofs remain blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt extension/transition publication; test lawful Retained→Deleted, already-present Deleted, forks, extra decisions and wrong identity.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Existing compatibility and historical not_ready are retained; plan is read-only and both surfaces share semantics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Read ordinary closes, v2 and unregistered v1 through repository/CLI/MCP, and test new plan/record input parity.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No fabricated historical authentication or remote immutable-anchor guarantee.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Document supported surviving-proof detection and complete local provenance-loss/rollback limits.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No recursive lock or unguarded writer, bounded failure for cyclic dependencies, no default permanent source-checkout dependency, damaged canonical records retain scope obligation and all required validity predicates remain conjunctive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise crate-private matching lock-guard callers, cross-WI cycles/depth, offline original source after complete registration, malformed/foreign canonical registration names and old-v1/provider failures with apparently valid registration.

intent.problem: Existing readable legacy-v1 recovery evidence has no new v2 origin requirement. Losing all legacy provenance can be indistinguishable from ordinary close; no historical origin may be fabricated. A new explicit present-day registration must remember complete proof obligations while preserving the known total-local-loss boundary and lawful append-only Retained-to-Deleted evolution.
intent.rationale: 将旧 v1 的已知来源丢失边界作为独立新范围，追加现时完整性义务；不重开已完成 WI-1084 或改写历史。

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Present-day explicit_attestation is truthful; original historical bytes and assurance remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a complete old-v1 source with historical producer distinct from present registrar; reject hash-only/incomplete sources.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Only exact original binding/bytes resume; pending does not permanently block its own recovery; conflicting or corrupt records remain preserved and rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt before/after requirement and registration publication; plan and record requirement-only and registration-only cases.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Single immutable winner, no lost update, stale/conflict on drift, no overwrite.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Race same/different WI and binding; change source/destination/inventory/head/admission after plan.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No escaped read/write or victim replacement; invalid inputs fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise bounded reads, duplicate keys/paths, symlink/reparse, directory replacement, traversal and hardlink victims.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Closed revoked, explicit blocker, WI retained in readiness, overlapping scope rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Remove/change each required record/dependency; remove archive directory or Contract+manifest; set closeRequired=false or foreign repository.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: One authoritative write sequence; typed held-lock/internal contract prevents recursive acquisition and unlocked exposure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Call normal finalization and explicit extension path with held/unheld lock contexts and concurrent writers.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Read back original exact transition and return original result; no regenerated actor/time/Runtime bytes and no false next-sequence conflict.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Publish exact transition, fail reporting, then retry with original durable template/version before evaluating next-sequence.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Exact constrained resume works without prior registered_valid/closed; unbound decisions, invalid forks and missing proofs remain blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Interrupt extension/transition publication; test lawful Retained→Deleted, already-present Deleted, forks, extra decisions and wrong identity.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: Existing compatibility and historical not_ready are retained; plan is read-only and both surfaces share semantics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Read ordinary closes, v2 and unregistered v1 through repository/CLI/MCP, and test new plan/record input parity.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No fabricated historical authentication or remote immutable-anchor guarantee.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Document supported surviving-proof detection and complete local provenance-loss/rollback limits.

scenarioCoverage.expectedOutcome: No recursive lock or unguarded writer, bounded failure for cyclic dependencies, no default permanent source-checkout dependency, damaged canonical records retain scope obligation and all required validity predicates remain conjunctive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise crate-private matching lock-guard callers, cross-WI cycles/depth, offline original source after complete registration, malformed/foreign canonical registration names and old-v1/provider failures with apparently valid registration.
